assessment.answer: Neither an administrative shoreline-only rule nor exact median/state-boundary construction for the frozen Kigoma/Katavi/Rukwa polygons was established. Original exporter documentation proves optional water clipping and explicitly covers LakeTanganyika by2019. Official sources establish statistical mapping purpose and country-level water share, not the historical source-specific outer edges.
assessment.precise_source_relative_obstacle: The frozen2015source lacks the exact original export timestamp/options (especially water versus LAND), OSM administrative relation/version lineage, and documentation identifying the original lake-boundary construction. Retained feature interiors show water inclusion but cannot supply those missing semantics. The known original TZA_ADM1 archive remains the finite direct provenance lead.
